analogy.rationale: Autotaxin (ENPP2) is a secreted lysophospholipase D that produces lysophosphatidic acid, so its inhibition mainly affects LPA receptor signaling; these cells express little autotaxin/LPA axis, and the annotated targets (ESR1/ESR2, MCL1) suggest weak, indirect transcriptional effects. The closest reference classes are lipid-signaling modulators (FAAH inhibitor, phospholipase activator) and estrogen receptor antagonism, with BCL inhibition as a weak downstream overlap.
